data.narrative:
Archetype AI is a Series A stage AI & Software company founded by Ivan Poupyrev, Brandon Barbello, Leonardo Giusti, Jaime Lien, and Nick Gillian that has raised $48M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a peer set of 9 companies (1 public, 8 private) operating in the same sector and comparable stage, including Scale AI, Reflection AI, Physical Intelligence, Black Forest Labs, and Field AI, with valuations ranging from $2.0B to $29.0B.

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis, using the $48M raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.0x multiplier typical of Series A advancement, implies a valuation of $96M. Peer-median analysis across the 5-company sample yields a median valuation of $5.6B, with a range between $2.0B and $29.0B. The peer set reflects both adjacent-stage companies (Series B) and same-stage comparables, capturing relevant market benchmarks for AI-focused software businesses.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $82M (low) to $6.4B (high), with a median of $2.8B. The extreme divergence between stage-progression and peer-median approaches reflects material uncertainty around whether Archetype's market position and growth profile more closely track early-stage funding norms or the premium valuations observed in recent frontier AI financings. Resolution of this gap depends critically on revenue scale, customer traction, and technical differentiation relative to the peer cohort.
